response.original_title: 『FAQs-Section』 How do I add a passenger on a Cunard Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Cunard Cruise booking, you must call Cunard Customer Service directly at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK), or contact your travel advisor, as passenger additions cannot be processed online.  Requirements and Rules  Cabin Capacity: Your stateroom must have the physical space and extra berth capacity (such as a sofa bed or upper Pullman) to accommodate an additional guest.  Lifeboat Limits: The ship must be under its maximum Coast Guard safety and lifeboat capacity.  Pricing: The booking will be recalculated and priced at the current, prevailing fare rate for the new passenger.  Information Needed: Have the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, and payment information ready when you call +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK).
